prior_v3_exposure: The dispatch identifies my prior run AK adjudication of these hold-out v3 identities on old cards; I acknowledge that exposure and did not consult it in this run.
notes: Teaching overrides named tools and models. Agent-tool comparisons need no tutorial; coding-game capability demos do not by themselves establish image/video artifacts. Grok sometimes inferred an acting agent or finished artifact from a model release; Gemini inferred business from generic hardware and Frontier Models from a paper mention. Whole-set dominance matters for broad interviews. Establish AI scope before choosing a child: generic hardware and terminal-code lack it, while subscription access alone supports the parent. The AI-provenance question is eligible prose despite missing captions. The truncated reasoning-heist fragment is too thin for either proposed child.
